source: 方案.md Appendix A and frozen operational definitions; summaries are deterministic, not generated at inference

descriptions.TXT_AFFECT_WORD_POSITIVE: Explicit positive-affect word or phrase; lexical presence, not sentence polarity.
descriptions.TXT_AFFECT_WORD_NEGATIVE: Explicit negative-affect word or phrase; lexical presence, not inferred emotion.
descriptions.TXT_EVALUATION_POSITIVE: Explicit positive evaluation of a person, event, object, or outcome.
descriptions.TXT_EVALUATION_NEGATIVE: Explicit negative evaluation of a person, event, object, or outcome.
descriptions.TXT_NEGATION_PRESENT: Semantically functioning negation; contrast and uncertainty alone do not qualify.
descriptions.TXT_INTENSIFIER_PRESENT: Explicit degree intensifier used to strengthen an expression.
descriptions.TXT_UNCERTAINTY_HEDGE: Explicit hedging expression that weakens commitment or certainty.
descriptions.TXT_RHETORICAL_QUESTION: A question functioning rhetorically rather than requesting information.
descriptions.TXT_EXCLAMATION_INTERJECTION: Explicit expressive interjection or exclamation; punctuation alone is insufficient.
descriptions.TXT_DESIRE_NEED: Explicitly expressed desire, wish, hope, need, or goal.
descriptions.TXT_EXPLICIT_CAUSAL_ATTRIBUTION_SELF: Explicit causal attribution of an event or outcome to oneself.
descriptions.TXT_EXPLICIT_CAUSAL_ATTRIBUTION_OTHER: Explicit causal attribution of an event or outcome to another person.
descriptions.TXT_EXPLICIT_SUCCESS_OUTCOME: Explicit success, achievement, victory, or goal attainment.
descriptions.TXT_EXPLICIT_FAILURE_LOSS_OUTCOME: Explicit failure, loss, rejection, or failure to attain a goal.
descriptions.AUD_SPEECH_RATE_REL_FAST: Faster speech relative to comparable segments from the same speaker.
descriptions.AUD_SPEECH_RATE_REL_SLOW: Slower speech relative to comparable segments from the same speaker.
descriptions.AUD_PITCH_LEVEL_REL_HIGH: Higher pitch relative to the same speaker acoustic baseline.
descriptions.AUD_PITCH_LEVEL_REL_LOW: Lower pitch relative to the same speaker acoustic baseline.
descriptions.AUD_VOCAL_INTENSITY_REL_HIGH: Higher vocal intensity relative to the same speaker baseline; exclude recording gain changes.
descriptions.AUD_VOCAL_INTENSITY_REL_LOW: Lower vocal intensity relative to the same speaker baseline; exclude recording gain changes.
descriptions.AUD_PITCH_VARIABILITY_HIGH: Clearly varying pitch across the observed speech.
descriptions.AUD_PITCH_VARIABILITY_LOW: Clearly limited pitch variation across the observed speech.
descriptions.AUD_PAUSE_LONG: Internal long pause meeting frozen duration rules; exclude file boundaries and missing audio.
descriptions.AUD_PAUSE_FREQUENT: Repeated internal pauses meeting frozen rules across the effective speech timeline.
descriptions.AUD_INTONATION_RISING: Clearly rising acoustic intonation; question grammar alone is insufficient.
descriptions.AUD_INTONATION_FLAT: Clearly flat or monotone intonation over sufficient speech.
descriptions.AUD_VOICE_TENSE: Audible tense, pressed, or effortful voice; loudness alone is insufficient.
descriptions.AUD_VOICE_TREMBLING: Clearly trembling or unstable voice; ordinary pitch changes do not qualify.
descriptions.AUD_CRYING_SOBBING_PRESENT: Clearly audible crying, sobbing, or a crying vocal event.
descriptions.VIS_BROWS_FURROWED: Visible inward brow contraction or furrowing; low brow position alone is insufficient.
descriptions.VIS_BROWS_RAISED: Clearly raised brows, beyond habitual brow shape.
descriptions.VIS_EYES_WIDENED: Clearly increased eye opening, beyond camera distance or habitual appearance.
descriptions.VIS_EYES_SQUINTED: Clearly narrowed or squinted eyes; blinking alone is insufficient.
descriptions.VIS_SMILE_PRESENT: Visible upward mouth corners or a clear smile configuration; no inferred happiness.
descriptions.VIS_MOUTH_CORNERS_DOWN: Clearly downward mouth corners, distinct from speaking or perspective effects.
descriptions.VIS_LIPS_PRESSED: Visible active lip pressing or flattening, beyond simple mouth closure.
descriptions.VIS_GRIMACE_PRESENT: Directly visible facial grimacing or distortion.
descriptions.VIS_TEARING_PRESENT: Visible tears or tear tracks; reflections and moist eyes alone are insufficient.
descriptions.VIS_HEAD_LOWERED: Head visibly lowered relative to the torso or pose; downward gaze alone is insufficient.
